name: Template confirmation
purpose: The page at the end of an instruction, in two states. Confirmation is a 380px column that ENDS a flow; a confirmation PAGE has to be the RECEIPT as well, so the ORDER changes and that order is the template's whole contribution: message column, then the FACTS, then the actions, then what happens next. Actions come after the facts because a person cannot decide what to do until they have read what was done.

Layer-2 rows have no ruled artefact form; this file ships in the library's grammar on the brief's PROPOSED convention (s182-D2, the Kpi-tile precedent). No registration was performed: no CATEGORIES entry, no MIGRATED_SNIPPETS entry, no component-types.json membership, no canon.css block, no _rulings.json line, no gen_kg_edges.py run, no git operation. Deleting this pair costs nothing because nothing points at it.
$layer-note: The wave-5 and wave-6 briefs PROPOSED the meta key `layer`. meta.schema.json is additionalProperties:false with patternProperties '^\\$' only, so a bare `layer` key FAILS probe P-1 (probe_meta_schema.py). `$layer` is the legal form and is what is used here - the correction #210 wave-5 lane C reported, carried forward, not re-discovered. A `$`-prefixed key is an ANNOTATION by the schema's own grammar: if Layer-2 membership is meant to be queryable structure it wants a real enum property and a schema amendment. Still open, still Dave's.

props.name: variant
props.$note: SUCCESS keeps Confirmation's rag/success roundel and its entrance animation. PENDING takes NO success device - see antiPatterns.

props.name: nextSteps
props.$note: An ORDERED list, because the steps are ordered and a bulleted list would say they are not.

variants.name: success
variants.use: The instruction is complete and irreversible from here. Roundel, entrance animation, a receipt Summary with an emphasised total, two equal actions, three next steps.

variants.name: pending
variants.use: Accepted but NOT finished. No roundel, no green, no entrance pop: a decorative glyph at alpha/40 and a Status-indicator chip carrying the meaning in a word, plus the expiry stated plainly.

tokens.success: rag/success - the SUCCESS variant's roundel only, carried WITH its driftAllow and its reason
tokens.chip: rag/warning + rag/warning-tint, via Status-indicator form B - the PENDING variant's word
tokens.buttons: the button/primary/*, button/tertiary/* and button/quaternary/* Mono ladder
tokens.$roundelPolicy: --success in DARK is #FFFFFF and that is NOT drift: it is Confirmation's own RAG ROUNDEL POLICY (Dave, 2026-07-02 eve). The tick is a page-cutout, so a white shape gives a black tick at 21:1, where rag/success #00847F with a black cutout measured 2.77 and failed the >=4.5 mark leg. The driftAllow entry and its reason travel together, because a policy that travels without its reason becomes a bug.
tokens.$noColouredMoney: ⛔ No monetary figure on either page is coloured. rag/success-ink and rag/error-ink are MONO ONLY (s155-D1 / s158-D2 / s158-D3).
tokens.$mono: MONO ONLY. No colour value is invented anywhere in this template. Every hex in both theme blocks appears in the theme block of a source component. The two-red law (s151-D1) and the mono error-ink camp (s149-D1) are untouched.
tokens.$noNewWidths: s210-D3 discipline: the template asserts page-scale layout only. No molecule inside it receives a new fixed width.

$composes: Confirmation (.confirm, .success, .confirm__title / __msg / __actions and the entrance animation - its raw font declarations dropped and its own .confirm .btn ladder NOT carried, because this page uses the Button ATOM), Summary (the receipt rows and the emphasised total row), Status-indicator (the pending chip, form B via Document-row), Empty-state (.empty .glyph, re-selected as .glyph, for the pending anchor), Stat-card (every panel surface), Button (every action, with its injected press-physics partial), Layout-utilities (.l-container).

accessibility.roles: No invented roles. Each specimen is a <main> whose message column is role="group" with aria-labelledby on the <h1>; each receipt is a real <dl> labelled by its panel heading; each next-steps list is an <ol>.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab order follows source order: primary action, secondary action. Two stops per page, which is the whole page.
accessibility.announcements: The pending chip is role="status". The success page announces nothing beyond its heading - the person arrived here, so the state is the destination.
accessibility.targets: MEASURED at 1400px: 220x44, 232x44, 304x44, 197x44. Every action clears 44px in both directions.
accessibility.$colourIsNeverAlone: The success roundel is aria-hidden and the HEADING carries the success (1.4.1). The pending chip carries its word and its dot is aria-hidden. The pending state also states its consequence in prose ('Nothing has left the account yet') rather than relying on the chip alone.
accessibility.$candidateSource: ⚠ Confirmation.reference.html is itself a CANDIDATE, not gated: its meta's provenance says 'REVIEW: no Figma node yet'. Borrowing it into a template does NOT promote it, and this file must not be cited as evidence that it is settled.

antiPatterns: Giving the PENDING variant a success device. Confirmation's roundel is built for a TICK: the mark is a page-cutout and the whole dark policy exists so that cutout stays legible. There is no ruled roundel for 'accepted but not finished', and minting one would be a decision inside the RAG policy's own neighbourhood.
Putting the actions before the facts. A person cannot decide what to do until they have read what was done.
Holding Confirmation's 380px at page scale. It broke 'Payment waiting for approval' after the word 'for'. The CONTAINER widens the column to 460px and asserts nothing about any molecule (s210-D3).
Animating the pending entrance. The pop is a success device.
Colouring the money. rag/*-ink is MONO ONLY and binding it here would rule on Dave's behalf.
Claiming irreversibility the product cannot honour. The success page says 'It cannot be recalled from here', which is a statement about THIS SURFACE and not about the payment scheme.
